ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed CreateDump Utility Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uses of a renamed legitimate createdump.exe LOLOBIN utility to dump process memory

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "FX\_VER\_INTERNALNAME\_STR" OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-full\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-name\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*")))) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\createdump\\\.exe$"))
